title: Flasque abelian sheaves are Cech acyclic for arbitrary open covers
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $G$ an abelian sheaf on its open site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and $(V_i)_{i\in I}$ a set-indexed family of open subsets with $V=\bigcup_{i\in I}V_i$. Suppose $G$ is flasque [def-sc-zariski-flasque], meaning that $G(B)\to G(A)$ is surjective for every inclusion of opens $A\subseteq B\subseteq X$. Then $\check H^p(\{V_i\to V\}_{i\in I},G)=0$ for every $p>0$. Here $\check H^p$ is the cohomology of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]: its degree-$p$ group is $\prod_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in I^{p+1}}G(V_{i_0}\cap\cdots\cap V_{i_p})$ and its differential is the alternating sum of restrictions, with repetitions allowed. No finiteness condition on $I$ or separation condition on $X$ is assumed.
